meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

copy.tagline: 创建或更新扩展能力的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想为Claude创建或更新自定义技能
copy.tagline_en: Create or update skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create or update custom skills for Claude

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成技能创建助手，引导你一步步设计、编写和打包技能文件（SKILL.md 和资源文件夹），并验证技能是否符合规范。
howto.when: 当你明确表示想创建一个新技能或更新现有技能时触发。

say.text: 我想创建一个 PDF 编辑技能，帮我规划步骤。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成技能创建流程。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个名为 my-skill 的技能目录。
say.note: Claude 会运行 init_skill.py 生成模板。

say.text: 验证并打包我的技能文件夹。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a skill creation assistant, guiding you step by step to design, write, and package skill files (SKILL.md and resource folders), and validate the skill against requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly state you want to create a new skill or update an existing one.

say_en.text: I want to create a PDF editing skill, help me plan the steps.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the skill creation process.

say_en.text: Initialize a skill directory named my-skill for me.
say_en.note: Claude will run init_skill.py to generate the template.

say_en.text: Validate and package my skill folder.
say_en.note: Claude will run package_skill.py to check and create a zip.
